heading: Monitoring system
lead: The head of each executive agency shall designate one office, officer, or employee of the agency—

tree.text: to establish and operate a central monitoring system for the motor vehicle operations of the agency, related activities, and related reporting requirements; and
provide oversight of those operations, activities, and requirements.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 1750240:901.Pub. L. 99–272, title XV, § 15301, Apr. 7, 1986, 100 Stat. 335. In this chapter, the words “executive agency” are substituted for “executive agency, including the Department of Defense” to eliminate unnecessary words.
